blocks.text: Butyn dynja işci ve kojlilernin. jоlваşçьsь V. I. Lenin

translations.en: Leader of the workers and peasants of the whole world V. I. Lenin

blocks.text: Lenin Bin sekiz jyz jetmiş senesi 22 aprыlde. „Uljanovsk" şeherinde doğdь. Bin doquz jyz jigrimi dort senesi 21 janvarda, Moskva janыndaki „Gorki" degen kej de eldi.

translations.en: Lenin was born in Uljanovsk on 22 April, 1885. He died in Moscow on 21 January in Gorki.

blocks.text: Lenin Bizim Bаваmыz. Biz Leninin Balalaramiz.

translations.en: Lenin is our father. We are Lenin's children.
